newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Brussels airport traffic rises 7.8 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Brussels airport traffic rises 7.8 pct in 1996.

text.p: Traffic at Brussels airport rose by nearly eight percent in 1996, the airport authority said on Tuesday.
"With a growth rate of 7.8 percent, well above the European average, the number of aircraft movements amounts to 263,854," it said in a statement.
The increase mainly reflected a 9.22 percent rise in scheduled passenger services and a 9.91 percent jump for full cargo flights, it said.
But the airport still dropped to sixth place in the European ranking as Copenhagen's increase in movements was even higher.
Passenger traffic in Brussels rose 7.21 percent, compared with an 11.05 percent rise a year earlier. But it was better than the European average, which showed a 6.0 percent rise.
With a total of 13.55 million passengers, Brussels airport held on to 16th place in Europe.

The London route remained the top destination with a 2.4 percent rise to 1.2 million passengers -- nine percent of the total -- despite competition from the Eurostar high-speed train link between Brussels and London.
But competition of the Thalys fast-train link shaved passenger traffic to Paris by 5.9 percent.
